paite: Ephraim in thu agen lai in, midangte aling ua; Israel ah amah-le-amah akiliansak; himahleh Baal milim bia in, asita hi.
heading: Israel Tung A Thukhenna Nanung
english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

paite: Huchi in akhial semsem ua, adangka un milim sun abawl ua, amau theihtheihna dungzui a milimte mahmah avek ua khutsiam mite nasep; kithoih mite'n bawngnoute tawp uhen! chi in huaite tungthu agen uhi.
english: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’

paite: Huaiziak in zingsang meipi, daitui hulmang pah bang, phual a kipan a pingpei lak a buhsi bang a mutleng leh meikhu suahna a kipan a meikhu bang ahi ding uhi.
english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.

paite: Hinapi in kei Aigupta gam a kipan TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; kei lou ngal pathian na thei kei ding, kei chih louh hondampa a-om kei hi.
english: “Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

paite: Gamdai ah ka hon theita a, khokhalna gam ah.
english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

paite: Aloupa hing nou mitmet mun uh bang in, amaute hihdim in a-om ua; hihdim in a-om ua, huan alungtang uh hihlet in a-om; huaiziak in kei ahon mangngilhta uhi.
english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute a ding in humpinelkai bang ka hi a; gialbem bang in lampi kiang ah ka tang ding hi.
english: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.

paite: Vompi anoute suun bang in amaute ka maituah ding a, alungtang ua kipan alap uh ka kaikhe ding; huai ah humpinelkai bang in amaute ka ne bei ding; gamsa bang in amaute ka botnen ding hi.
english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

paite: Aw Israel, na panpihpa dou a, kei na hon dou, na siatna ahi.
english: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

paite: Na khopi tengteng a nang hon hondam ding na kumpipa tua koi a om ahia? Kumpipa leh heutute hon pi un, na chihnate uh, na vaihawmte uh koi ah?
english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?

paite: Hehngoh in kumpipa ka hon pia a, hehngoh in amah ka lamangta hi.
english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

paite: Ephraim thulimlouhna koih hoih in a-om a, akhelhna chiamtehna akoih in a-om hi.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

paite: Numei nauvei lungkhamna atung ah ahong tung ding; tapa pil lou suang ahi a, naupian hun tungta a, amun a a-omom ding ahita ngal kei a.
english: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.

paite: Han thilhihtheihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding a; sihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding; Aw sihna, na gu koi ah a-om ua? Aw han, na hihsiatna koi ah a-om a? Ka mit a kipan kisikna sel ahi ding hi.
english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.

paite: A-unaute lak ah gahpha mahleh, suahlam huih ahong kuan dia, gamdai a kipan TOUPA huih ahong nung dia, atui nak ahong keu dia, aluikhuk akang vek ding; bel kipahhuai tengteng a agou loh in a-om ding hi.
english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

paite: Samaria in amoh apo ding; a Pathian tung ah ahel a; namsau in apuk ding ua; anaungekte uh paihgawp in a-om ding uh, nau toh kithuah a numeite uh dawt pailet in a-om ding uhi.
english: Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”
